children: CGI has acquired Callibrity, a Cincinnati-based technology consulting firm as it looks to expand its enterprise artificial intelligence and platform engineering offering across the Midwestern U.S.

The acquisition, which closed on Tuesday, strengthens the Montreal-based IT and professional services company's operational presence in Ohio while enhancing its service offerings for commercial industries across financial services, insurance and manufacturing.
No financial details were disclosed. CGI said that about 120 consultants will join CGI from the Cincinnati metro market.
